Quran-e-Azeem ki ihanat se bachao matlab yeh hai ke Quran jo haq ki taraf nihayat safai aur wazahat se nazil hua hai. Is ki roshan ayatein tujh par tilawat ki ja rahi hain. Jise yeh sun rahe hain aur phir bhi na iman late hain na amal karte hain to phir aakhir iman kis cheez par layenge? In ke liye wail hai aur un par afsos hai jo zaban ke jhoote kaam ke gunahgar aur dil ke kafir hain, is ki baatein sunte hue apne kufr, inkar aur bad-batini par ade hue hain, goya suna hi nahin. Inhein suna do ke in ke liye Allah ke han dukh ki maar hai. Quran ki ayatein in ke mazaq ki cheez reh gayi hain. To jis tarah yeh mere kalam ki aaj ihanat karte hain, kal main inhein zillat ki saza dunga. Hadith-e-Sharif mein hai ke Quran le kar dushmanon ke mulk mein na jao, aisa na ho ke woh is ki ihanat-o-beqadri karein. Phir is zaleel karne wale ke azab ka bayan farmaya ke in khaslaton wale log jahannam mein dale jayenge. In ke maal-o-aulad aur in ke woh jhoote mabood jinhein yeh zindagi bhar poojte rahe, inhein kuch kaam na ayenge. Inhein zabardast aur bahut bade azab bhugatne padenge. Phir irshad hua ke yeh Quran sarasar hidayat hai aur is ki ayat se jo munkir hain, un ke liye sakht aur almnak azab hain. Wallahu Subhan-o-Ta'ala A'alam.

Allah Ta'ala ke Ibn-e-Adam par ehsanat. Allah Ta'ala apni ne'matein bayan farma raha hai ke isi ke hukm se samundar mein apni marzi ke mutabiq safar tay karte hue badi badi kashtiyan maal aur sawariyon se ladi hui idhar se udhar le jate ho, tijaratein aur kamai karte ho. Yeh is liye bhi hai ke tum Allah ka shukr baja lao, nafa hasil kar ke Rabb ka ehsan mano. Phir us ne aasman ki cheez jaise suraj, chand, sitare aur zameen ki cheez jaise pahad, nahrein aur tumhare faide ki beshumar cheezein tumhare liye musakhkhar kar di, yeh sab us ka fazl-o-ehsan, inaam-o-ikram hai aur isi ek ki taraf se hai, jaise irshad hai aayat (وَمَا بِكُمْ مِّنْ نِّعْمَةٍ فَمِنَ اللّٰهِ ثُمَّ اِذَا مَسَّكُمُ الضُّرُّ فَاِلَيْهِ تَجْــــَٔــرُوْنَ) (Surah An-Nahl: 53), yani tumhare paas jo ne'matein hain sab Allah ki di hui hain aur abhi bhi sakhti ke waqt tum isi ki taraf gidgidate ho. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain har cheez Allah hi ki taraf se hai aur yeh naam is mein naam hai us ke naamon mein se, pas yeh sab us ki janib se hai, koi nahin jo us se cheena-jhapti ya jhagda kar sake, har ek is yaqeen par hai ke woh isi tarah hai. Ek shakhs ne Hazrat Abdullah bin Umar (R.A) se sawal kiya ke makhlooq kis cheez se banai gayi hai? Aap ne farmaya noor se aur aag se aur andhere se aur mitti se aur kaha jao Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) ko agar dekho to un se bhi daryaft kar lo. Us ne aap se bhi poocha, yahi jawab paya. Phir farmaya wapas un ke paas jao aur poocho ke yeh sab kis cheez se paida kiye gaye? Woh lauta aur sawal kiya to aap ne yahi aayat padh kar sunai. Yeh asar ghareeb hai aur sath hi munkar bhi hai. Gaur-o-fikr ki aadat rakhne walon ke liye is mein bhi bahut nishaniyan hain. Phir farmata hai ke sabr-o-tahamul ki aadat daalo, munkireen-e-Qayamat ki kadwi-kaseeli sun liya karo, mushrik aur Ahl-e-Kitab ki ezaon ko bardasht kar liya karo. Yeh hukm shuru-e-Islam mein tha lekin baad mein Jihad aur jala-watni ke ahkaam nazil hue. Allah ke dinon ki umeed nahin rakhte, yani Allah ki ne'maton ke hasil karne ki koshish nahin karte. Phir farmaya ke un se tum chashm-poshi karo, un ke a'maal ki saza khud hum unhein denge, isi liye is ke baad hi farmaya ke tum sab isi ki taraf lautaye jaoge aur har neki-badi ki jaza-saza paoge. Wallahu Subhanuhu wa Ta'ala A'lam.

Tabrani mein hai ke Hazrat Tameem Dari (R.A) raat bhar tahajjud mein isi aayat ko baar baar padhte rahe yahan tak ke subh ho gayi. Phir farmata hai Allah Ta'ala ne aasman-o-zameen ko adl ke sath paida kiya hai, woh har ek shakhs ko us ke kiye ka badla dega aur kisi par us ki taraf se zara sa bhi zulm na kiya jayega. Yeh aayat Mu'tazila ke us usool ko rad karti hai ke achhai-burai aqli hai. Hazrat Imam Malik (R.H) is ki tafsir karte hue farmate hain: Us ke dil mein jis ki ibadat ka khayal guzarta hai usi ko poojne lagta hai. Musnad-e-Abu Ya'la mein hai, Hazrat Abu Zar (R.A) farmate hain: Chaar cheezon par Allah Ta'ala ne apne deen ki bina rakhi hai, jo in se hat jaye aur in par aamil na bane woh Allah se fasiq ho kar mulaqat karega. Poocha gaya ke woh charon cheezein kya hain? Farmaya: Yeh ke kamil aqeeda rakhe ke halal, haram, hukm aur muman'at, yeh charon sirf Allah ke ikhtiyar mein hain. Us ke halal ko halal, us ke haram bataye hue ko haram manna, us ke hukmon ko qabil-e-tameel aur laiq-e-tasleem janna, us ke mana kiye hue kamon se baaz aa jana aur halal-o-haram, amr-o-nahi ka malik sirf usi ko janna, bas yeh deen ki asl hai. Hazrat Abul Qasim (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka farman hai ke jis tarah babool ke darakht se angoor paida nahin ho sakte, isi tarah badkar log nek karon ka darja hasil nahin kar sakte. Yeh hadith ghareeb hai. Seerat-e-Muhammad bin Ishaq mein hai ke Ka'batullah ki neev mein se ek patthar nikla tha jis par likha hua tha ke tum buraiyan karte hue nekiyon ki umeed rakhte ho? Yeh bilkul aisa hi hai jaise koi khardar darakht mein se angoor chunna chahta ho. Tabrani mein hai ke Hazrat Tameem Dari (R.A) raat bhar tahajjud mein isi aayat ko baar baar padhte rahe yahan tak ke subh ho gayi. Phir farmata hai Allah Ta'ala ne aasman-o-zameen ko adl ke sath paida kiya hai, woh har ek shakhs ko us ke kiye ka badla dega aur kisi par us ki taraf se zara sa bhi zulm na kiya jayega. Phir Allah Ta'ala Jalla-o-Ala farmata hai ke tum ne unhein bhi dekha jo apni khwahishon ko Allah banaye hue hain? Jis kaam ki taraf tabiyat jhuki kar dala, jis se dil ruka chhod diya. Yeh aayat Mu'tazila ke us usool ko rad karti hai ke achhai-burai aqli hai. Hazrat Imam Malik (R.H) is ki tafsir karte hue farmate hain: Us ke dil mein jis ki ibadat ka khayal guzarta hai usi ko poojne lagta hai. Is ke baad ke jumle ke do ma'ni hain: Ek toh yeh ke Allah Ta'ala ne apne ilm ki bina par use mustahiq-e-gumrahi jaan kar gumrah kar diya. Dusra ma'ni yeh ke us ke paas ilm-o-hujjat, daleel-o-sanad aa gayi phir use gumrah kiya. Yeh dusri baat pehli ko bhi mustalzim hai aur pehli dusri ko mustalzim nahin. Us ke kanon par mohar hai, nafa dene wali shar'i baat sunta hi nahin. Us ke dil par mohar hai, hidayat ki baat dil mein utarti hi nahin. Us ki aankhon par parda hai, koi daleel use dikhti hi nahin. Bhala ab Allah ke baad use kaun raah dikhaye? Kya tum ibrat hasil nahin karte? Jaise farmaya aayat: (Man yudlilillahu fala hadiya lahu, wa yazaruhum fi tughyanihim ya'mahoon) (7:186).

(Al-A'raf: 186) Jise Allah gumrah kar de us ka hadi koi nahin, woh unhein chhor deta hai ke apni sarkashi mein bhatakte rahein.

Zamanay ko gaali mat do. Dahriya kuffar aur un ke hum-aqeeda mushrikeen ka bayan ho raha hai ke yeh Qayamat ke munkir hain aur kehte hain ke duniya hi ibtida aur intiha hai, kuch jeetay hain kuch martay hain, Qayamat koi cheez nahin. Falasifa aur ilm-e-kalam ke qail yahi kehte thay. Yeh log ibtida aur intiha ke qail na thay aur falasifa mein se jo log dahriya aur dawriya thay woh Khaliq ke bhi munkir thay. Un ka khayal tha ke har chhatees hazaar saal ke baad zamanay ka aik daur khatam hota hai aur har cheez apni asli halat par aa jati hai aur aisay kayi daur ke woh qail thay. Darasal yeh maqool se bhi bekar jhagartay thay aur manqool se bhi ro-gardani kartay thay aur kehte thay ke gardish-e-zamana hi halak karne wali hai na ke Allah. Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya is ki koi daleel un ke paas nahin aur bajuz wahm-o-khayal ke koi sanad woh pesh nahin kar saktay. Abu Dawood waghera ki sahih hadith mein hai, Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya: Allah Ta'ala farmata hai mujhe Ibn-e-Adam eeza deta hai, woh dahr ko (yani zamanay ko) gaaliyan deta hai, darasal zamana mein hi hoon, tamam kaam mere haath mein hain, din raat ka her-pher karta hoon. Aik riwayat mein hai: Dahr (zamana) ko gaali na do, Allah hi zamana hai. Ibn-e-Jareer ne isay aik bilkul ghareeb sanad se warid kiya hai, is mein hai: Ahl-e-Jahiliyat ka khayal tha ke hamain din raat hi halak kartay hain, wohi hamain martay jalatay hain, pas Allah Ta'ala ne apni Kitab-e-Kareem mein isay naqal farmaya, woh zamanay ko bura kehte thay, pas Allah Azza-wa-Jal ne farmaya: Mujhe Ibn-e-Adam eeza pohanchata hai, woh zamanay ko bura kehta hai aur zamana mein hoon, mere haath mein sab kaam hain, mein din raat ka le aanay le jaanay wala hoon. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai: Ibn-e-Adam zamanay ko gaaliyan deta hai, mein zamana hoon, din raat mere haath mein hain. Aur hadith mein hai: Mein ne apne banday se qarz talab kiya us ne mujhe na diya, mujhe mere banday gaaliyan dein, woh kehta hai haye haye zamana, aur zamana mein hoon.

Imam Shafi'i aur Abu Ubaidah wagairah aimma-e-lughat-o-tafsir is hadith ki sharah mein farmate hain ke jahiliyat ke arabon ko jab koi bala aur shiddat-o-takleef pahunchti to woh use zamane ki taraf nisbat karte aur zamane ko bura kehte. Dar-asal zamana khud to kuch karta nahin, har kaam ka karta-dharta Allah Ta'ala hi hai, is liye is ka zamane ko gaali dena fi-alwaqay use bura kehna tha jis ke haath mein aur jis ke bas mein zamana hai, jo rahat-o-ranj ka maalik hai aur woh Zaat-e-Bari Ta'ala Azzasmuhu hai. Pas woh gaali haqiqi fa'il yani Allah Ta'ala par padti hai, is liye is hadith mein Allah ke Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne yeh farmaya aur logon ko is se rok diya. Yehi sharah bahut theek aur bilkul durust hai. Imam Ibn Hazm wagairah ne is hadith se jo yeh samajh liya hai ke Dahr Allah ke Asma-e-Husna mein se ek naam hai, yeh bilkul ghalat hai, wallahu a'lam.

Phir in be-ilmon ki kaj-bakhti bayan ho rahi hai ke Qayamat qaim hone ki aur dobara jalaye jaane ki bilkul saaf daleelein jab unhein di jaati hain aur qail-o-maqool kar diya jaata hai to chunke jab kuch ban nahin padta, jhat se keh dete hain ke achha phir hamare murda baap-dadon, pardadon ko zinda kar ke hamein dikha do to hum maan lenge. Allah Ta'ala farmata hai tum apna paida kiya jaana aur mar jaana to apni aankh se dekh rahe ho ke tum kuch na the aur us ne tumhein maujood kar diya, phir woh tumhein maar daalta hai, to jo ibtida paida karne par qadir hai woh dobara jee uthane par qadir kaise na hoga? Balkay aqlan hidayat (wazeh taur par) ke saath yeh baat sabit hai ke jo shuru shuru kisi cheez ko bana de, us par dobara us ka banana ba-nisbat pehli dafa ke bahut aasaan hota hai.

Pas yahan farmaya ke phir woh tumhein Qayamat ke din jis ke aane mein koi shak nahin, jama karega. Woh duniya mein tumhein dobara laane ka nahin jo tum keh rahe ho ke hamare baap-dadon ko zinda kar lao. Yeh to dar-e-amal hai, dar-e-jaza Qayamat ka din hai. Yahan to har ek ko thodi bahut takheer mil jaati hai jis mein woh agar chahe is dusre ghar ke liye taiyariyan kar sakta hai. Bas apni be-ilmi ki bina par tumhein is ka inkar na karna chahiye. Tum go ise door jaan rahe ho lekin dar-asal woh qareeb hi hai, tum go is ka aana muhaal samajh rahe ho lekin fi-alwaqay is ka aana yaqeeni hai. Momin ba-ilm aur zi-aql hain ke woh is par yaqeen-e-kamil rakh kar amal mein lage hue hain.

Us din har shakhs ghutnon ke bal gira hua hoga, ab se le kar hamesha tak aur aaj se pehle bhi tamam aasmanon ka, kul zameenon ka maalik, badshah, sultan Allah Ta'ala hi hai. Allah ke aur uski kitabon ke aur uske rasoolon ke munkir Qayamat ke roz bade ghate mein rahenge. Hazrat Sufyan Sauri R.H jab Madine Sharif mein tashreef laye to aap ne suna ke Mu'afiri ek zareef shakhs hain, logon ko apne kalam se hansaya karte hain, to aap ne unhein nasihat ki aur farmaya kyun janab kya aap ko maloom nahin ke ek din aayega jis mein baatil wale khasare mein padenge. Is ka bahut achha asar hua aur Hazrat Mu'afiri marte dam tak is nasihat ko na bhoole (Ibn Abi Hatim). Woh din aisa holnak aur sakht tar hoga ke har shakhs ghutnon par gir jayega. Yahan tak ke Khalilullah Hazrat Ibrahim A.S aur Roohullah Hazrat Isa A.S bhi. Un ki zaban se bhi us waqt (Nafsi, Nafsi, Nafsi) niklega. Saaf keh denge ke Allah aaj hum tujh se aur kuch nahin mangte, sirf apni salamti chahte hain. Hazrat Isa A.S farmayenge ke aaj main apni walida ke liye bhi tujh se kuch arz nahin karta, bas mujhe bacha le. Go baaz mufassireen ne kaha hai ke murad yeh hai ke har giroh judagana alag alag hoga lekin is se awla aur behtar wahi tafseer hai jo hum ne ki, yani har ek apne zanoo par gira hua hoga. Ibn Abi Hatim mein hai Huzoor ﷺ farmate hain goya ke main tumhein Jahannam ke paas zanoo par jhuke hue dekh raha hoon. Aur marfoo hadith mein jis mein Soor waghera ka bayan hai yeh bhi hai ke phir log juda juda kar diye jayenge aur tamam ummatein zanoo par jhuki padengi, yahi Allah ka farman hai aayat (وَتَرٰى كُلَّ اُمَّةٍ جَاثِيَةً ۣ كُلُّ اُمَّةٍ تُدْعٰٓى اِلٰى كِتٰبِهَا ۭ اَلْيَوْمَ تُجْزَوْنَ مَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُوْنَ 28؀) (45-Al-Jasiyah: 28), is mein dono halatein jama kar di hain, pas darasal dono tafseeron mein ek dusre ke khilaf nahin, Wallahu A'lam. Phir farmaya har giroh apne nama-e-a'maal ki taraf bulaya jayega. Hamein agarche kuch yun hi sa wahm hota hai lekin hargiz yaqeen nahin ke Qayamat zaroor aaye gi hi. Ab un ki bad-a'maliyon ki saza un ke samne aa gayi, apni aankhon apne kartoot ka badla dekh chuke aur jis azab-o-saza ka inkar karte the, jise mazaq mein udate the jis ka hona namumkin samajh rahe the un azabon ne unhein charon taraf se gher liya aur unhein har qisam ki bhalai se mayoos karne ke liye keh diya gaya ke hum tumhare sath wahi mamla karenge jaise koi kisi ko bhool jata hai, yani Jahannam mein jhonk kar phir tumhein kabhi achayi se yaad bhi na karenge. Sahih Hadith-e-Sharif mein hai ke Allah Ta'ala apne ba'az bandon se Qayamat ke din farmaye ga kya main ne tujhe baal-bachay nahin diye the? Kya main ne tujh par duniya mein inaam-o-ikram nazil nahin farmaye the? Kya main ne tere liye oonton aur ghoron ko muti' aur farmabardar nahin kiya tha? Aur tujhe chhor diya tha ke suroor-o-khushi ke sath apne makanat aur haveliyon mein azadi ki zindagi basar kare? Yeh jawab de ga ke mere Parwardigar yeh sab sach hai beshak tere yeh tamam ehsanat mujh par the. Allah Ta'ala farmaye ga pas aaj main tujhe is tarah bhula doon ga jis tarah tu mujhe bhool gaya tha. Phir farmata hai ke yeh sazayein tumhein isliye di gayi hain ke tum ne Allah Ta'ala ki aayaton ka khoob mazaq udaya tha. Aur duniya ki zindagi ne tumhein dhoke mein daal rakha tha tum isi par mutma'in the aur is qadar tum ne be-fikri barti ke aakhir aaj nuqsan aur khasare mein par gaye.

Jaise ke momin baghair azaab-o-hisaab ke jannat mein jayenge. Aise hi tum be-hisaab azaab kiye jao ge aur tumhari tauba be-sood rahe gi. Apne is faisle ko jo mominon aur kafiron mein ho gaya bayan farma kar ab irshad farmata hai ke tamam hamd zameen-o-aasman aur har cheez ke maalik Allah Ta'ala hi ke liye hai. Jo kul jahan ka paal-nehar hai usi ko kibriyai yani saltanat aur badai aasmanon aur zameeno mein hai woh badi azmat aur buzurgi wala hai. Har cheez us ke samne past hai har ek us ka mohtaj hai. Us ka koi qaul koi fe'l us ki shariat ka koi masla us ki likhi hui taqdeer ka koi harf hikmat se khali nahin na us ke siwa koi masjood. Ab tumhara thikana Jahannam hai aur koi nahin jo tumhari kisi qisam ki madad kar sake. Sahih Hadith-e-Sharif mein hai ke Allah Ta'ala apne ba'az bandon se Qayamat ke din farmaye ga kya main ne tujhe baal-bachay nahin diye the? Kya main ne tujh par duniya mein inaam-o-ikram nazil nahin farmaye the? Kya main ne tere liye oonton aur ghoron ko muti' aur farmabardar nahin kiya tha? Aur tujhe chhor diya tha ke suroor-o-khushi ke sath apne makanat aur haveliyon mein azadi ki zindagi basar kare? Yeh jawab de ga ke mere Parwardigar yeh sab sach hai beshak tere yeh tamam ehsanat mujh par the. Allah Ta'ala farmaye ga pas aaj main tujhe is tarah bhula doon ga jis tarah tu mujhe bhool gaya tha. Phir farmata hai ke yeh sazayein tumhein isliye di gayi hain ke tum ne Allah Ta'ala ki aayaton ka khoob mazaq udaya tha. Aur duniya ki zindagi ne tumhein dhoke mein daal rakha tha tum isi par mutma'in the aur is qadar tum ne be-fikri barti ke aakhir aaj nuqsan aur khasare mein par gaye.

Ab tum dozakh se nikale na jao ge aur na tum se hamari khafgi ke door karne ki koi wajah talab ki jaye gi yani is azaab se tumhara chhutkara bhi muhaal aur ab meri razamandi ka tumhein hasil hona bhi namumkin. Jaise ke momin baghair azaab-o-hisaab ke jannat mein jayenge. Aise hi tum be-hisaab azaab kiye jao ge aur tumhari tauba be-sood rahe gi. Apne is faisle ko jo mominon aur kafiron mein ho gaya bayan farma kar ab irshad farmata hai ke tamam hamd zameen-o-aasman aur har cheez ke maalik Allah Ta'ala hi ke liye hai. Jo kul jahan ka paal-nehar hai usi ko kibriyai yani saltanat aur badai aasmanon aur zameeno mein hai woh badi azmat aur buzurgi wala hai. Har cheez us ke samne past hai har ek us ka mohtaj hai. Sahih Muslim Sharif ki hadith-e-qudsi mein hai Allah Ta'ala jalla wa ala farmata hai azmat mera tehband hai aur kibriyai meri chadar hai jo shakhs in mein se kisi ko bhi mujh se lena chahe ga main use jahannam raseed kar dunga. Yani badai aur takabbur karne wala dozakhi hai. Woh Aziz hai yani ghalib hai jo kabhi kisi se maghloob nahin hone ka koi nahin jo us par rok tok kar sake. Us ke samne pad sake woh Hakim hai. Us ka koi qaul koi fe'l us ki shariat ka koi masla us ki likhi hui taqdeer ka koi harf hikmat se khali nahin na us ke siwa koi masjood. Allah Ta'ala ke fazl-o-karam aur us ke lutf-o-rahm se Surah Jathiya ki tafsir khatam hui aur isi ke sath pachiswein pare ki tafsir khatam hui. Falhamdulillah.
